{{Current events|year=2020|month=01|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)]]
**The [[Turkey|Turkish]] [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Grand National Assembly]] votes 325–184 to send [[Turkish Armed Forces|troops]] to help the internationally-recognized [[Government of National Accord]] in [[Libya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/turkey-parliament-approves-military-deployment-libya-200102113511422.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–present)]], [[Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present)]], Aftermath of the [[Attack on the United States embassy in Baghdad]]
**[[2020 Baghdad International Airport airstrike|A missile strike]] hits a convoy near [[Baghdad International Airport]] in [[Iraq]], killing [[Iran]]ian [[Major general]] [[Qasem Soleimani]] and [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] leader [[Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/middle-east/top-iran-commander-qasem-soleimani-killed-in-baghdad-raid-iraqi-state-tv-32678 (TRT World)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 New Taipei helicopter crash]]
**A [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk|UH-60 Black Hawk]] helicopter carrying 13 people crashes in [[New Taipei]], [[Taiwan]]. Eight people are killed, including the [[Chief of the General Staff (Republic of China)|Chief of the General Staff]] [[Shen Yi-ming]], the head of the [[Republic of China Armed Forces]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/02/taiwans-military-chief-missing-helicopter-crash (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019–20 Australian bushfire season]]
**[[New South Wales]] [[Premier of New South Wales|Premier]] [[Gladys Berejiklian]] declares a [[state of emergency]] for seven days starting on January 3. [https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/nsw-premier-gladys-berejiklian-declares-state-of-emergency/news-story/8651cf93eb1fe85e3866221ed567a88c (News.com.au)]
**An elderly woman dies of suffocation while leaving a [[Brisbane]], [[Queensland]]-originated [[Qantas]] plane at [[Canberra Airport]]. [[Canberra]]'s [[air quality]] had been reported as the worst in the world because of heavy smoke from the bushfires in [[New South Wales]]. [https://www.news.com.au/travel/travel-updates/incidents/woman-dies-from-bushfire-smoke-in-canberra-after-exiting-qantas-plane/news-story/280f1c9bb729c5c4f3377f97936b5cda (News.com.au)]
** A second person is confirmed dead in the [[East Gippsland]] region of [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] as thousands of people are evacuated from [[Mallacoota, Victoria|Mallacoota]] by sea. [[Premier of Victoria|State premier]] [[Daniel Andrews]] has declared a [[state of disaster]] in six government areas. 17 people remain missing. [https://www.news.com.au/technology/environment/australian-troops-prepare-for-bushfire-emergency-evacuations-by-sea/live-coverage/cf3d149ec9bbb9b7eb808e663eec8a28 (News.com.au)]
*A military plane crashes shortly after takeoff from an airport in [[Sudan]]'s [[West Darfur]], killing the 18 people on board. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50978258 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[China–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[China]] temporarily suspends plans to cross-link companies on the [[London Stock Exchange|London]] and [[Shanghai Stock Exchange]] due to increased political tensions between the two nations, particularly [[United Kingdom|Britain]]'s stance on the [[2019–2020 Hong Kong protests|Hong Kong protests]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-britain-ipos-exclusive/exclusive-china-halts-british-stock-link-over-political-tensions-sources-idUSKBN1Z108L (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Lebanese justice minister says he has received an [[arrest warrant]] from [[Interpol]] against former Chairman of [[Nissan]], [[Carlos Ghosn]], who escaped [[house arrest]] in [[Japan]] and fled to [[Lebanon]] days ago. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/lebanese-justice-minister-says-lebanon-has-received-an-interpol-issued-wanted-notice-for-nissans-ex-chair-carlos-ghosn/2020/01/02/5641ca3c-2d5c-11ea-bffe-020c88b3f120_story.html (AP via Washington Post)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[United States Secretary of Housing and Urban Development|Secretary of Housing and Urban Development]] [[Julian Castro]] drops out of the presidential race. [https://www.npr.org/2020/01/02/774556481/julian-castro-drops-out-of-the-democratic-presidential-race (NPR)]
*[[Italy]]'s ruling [[Five Star Movement]] expels [[Senate of the Republic (Italy)|Senator]] [[Gianluigi Paragone]] from its ranks over disciplinary issues, shrinking [[Conte II Cabinet|the coalition]]'s majority in the Senate to five. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-5star/italys-5-star-expels-senator-further-reducing-slim-government-majority-idUSKBN1Z10T0?il=0 (Reuters)]
